title: Perceptive Humanoid Motion from Simulation
abstract: arXiv:2611.06908v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Humanoid robots have the potential to automate a wide range of physical tasks. Progress toward generalist humanoid autonomy, however, remains constrained by a data bottleneck: mapping pixels and free-form language to low-level joint commands requires paired supervision, and no corpus of such data exists at sufficiently large scale. Some approaches rely on human teleoperation and wearable capture devices, which require at least an hour of human time to produce an hour of data. We present HALO, a humanoid autonomy system powered by a pipeline that synthesizes vision-language-motion data across a thousand procedurally generated homes. The corpus scales with compute rather than human labor. HALO acquires a repertoire of physical skills, including sitting on chairs, navigating to named objects, stepping sideways through half-open doors, crouching and crawling beneath tables, and pushing boxes. translated_title: 基于仿真的具感知人形机器人运动
translated_abstract: 人形机器人有潜力自动化广泛的物理任务。然而，迈向通用型人形机器人自主能力的进展仍受限于数据瓶颈：将像素和自由形式的语言映射到底层关节命令需要成对的监督数据，而目前尚不存在足够大规模的此类数据语料库。一些方法依赖于人类遥操作和可穿戴动作捕捉设备，这需要至少一小时的人工时间才能产出一小时的数据。我们提出了HALO，这是一个由数据合成流水线驱动的人形机器人自主系统，该流水线在一千个程序化生成的家庭环境中合成视觉-语言-运动数据。该语料库的规模随算力而非人力扩展。HALO掌握了一系列物理技能，包括坐在椅子上、导航至指定名称的物体、侧身穿过半开的门、在桌下蹲伏和爬行，以及推箱子。它协调这些技能以解决复合任务。
tldr: 提出了HALO人形机器人自主系统，通过在千个程序化生成的家庭环境中合成视觉-语言-运动数据，使数据规模随算力而非人力扩展，让人形机器人掌握坐、导航、穿门、蹲爬、推箱等多种物理技能并协调完成复合任务。
en_tdlr: HALO is a humanoid autonomy system powered by a pipeline that synthesizes vision-language-motion data across a thousand procedurally generated homes, scaling with compute rather than human labor, and enabling humanoids to master diverse physical skills such as sitting, navigating, door traversal, crouching, and box pushing for composite task execution.
